hypothesis: Independent additive prior noise may hide reusable span and origin/destination signal; evaluate predicting withheld weak-prior entries without their values as features.
assignment: Fixed shuffled OD entries, one path per OD; all seeds and folds reported, no best-seed selection
features: Geometry only: normalized positive zone span cubic spline with fixed interior knots .05/.1/.2/.4/.6/.8, origin/destination one-hot, intercept. No prior target or loaded-count-derived feature.
models: Global training mean; span; origin/destination; span+origin/destination. Each nonconstant model reports all ridge penalties1/10/100, no tuning on evaluation entries.
target_scale: Median positive weak-prior value in each training fold only
score: MAE/RMSE on held-out weak prior, normalized by training scale; NOT hidden path accuracy or S_od. Clipped-zero predictions and clipping rate reported.
scope: Tests predictable weak-prior structure only. Independent/clipped noise assumptions can fail; this does not validate denoising real OD, and repeated public inputs are not blind. Frozen Task4 baseline retained, no Kaggle upload.
